run_encode_voxel_shapes: run the encode_many script to encode voxel shape examples into hidden state tensors using an autoencoder model
run_encode_with_sbatch: run the encode_many script in sbatch cluster mode without visdom visualization for batch processing
run_encode_with_dictionary: run the encode_many script with a loaded word dictionary to encode labeled voxel shape data
run_encode_color_io: run the encode_many script with color-alpha input mode for encoding colored voxel shapes
run_encode_custom_gpu: run the encode_many script on a specified GPU device for encoding voxel shape examples
